assertions.name: every_seifert_invariant_is_exactly_affine_in_A
assertions.unit: mismatches against the affine forms over 5 invariants x 6 nuclei
assertions.source: n=3A, crossings=12A-1, chi=-9A+1, mu=A+1, 2g=8A; all exact, all integral, all six N=Z nuclei

assertions.name: seifert_genus_is_exactly_four_A
assertions.source: the spanning surface named as the next step: built, and it is linear in A like everything else in the construction

assertions.name: exactly_one_averaged_weighted_crossing_at_every_A
assertions.unit: distinct counts of averaged_weighted across the chain
assertions.source: the only non-extensive feature in the construction: O(1), not O(A). O(1) is not A^(2/3) either, but it is the one place a non-extensive quantity exists here

description: EVERY Seifert invariant of the canonical braid closure is exactly affine in A on the six N=Z nuclei: n=3A, crossings=12A-1, chi=-9A+1, components=A+1, GENUS=4A. So the previous scope-(b) exclusion of the crossing count as a surface term extends to the whole Seifert package -- no invariant of this construction scales as A^(2/3), because the construction is affine in every coordinate. The gap is UPSTREAM: the framework's nuclear encoding has no surface to measure. The single `averaged_weighted` crossing (exactly 1 at every A) is the only non-extensive feature anywhere in it.

consequence.scope: (b) for any Seifert invariant of THIS construction as a surface term, via QOU.Mass.AffineCountIsNotASurfaceTerm's strictly-monotone ratio, which applies verbatim to each affine invariant
consequence.where_the_gap_actually_is: upstream of the surface term: the encoding is a word of length linear in A on a strand count linear in A, so every derived invariant inherits that. A surface term needs geometry the encoding does not carry
consequence.indexing_bug_recorded: a first pass assumed 1-based generators, got half-integral genus and 'components = 2', which reads as a SPLIT canonical closure. That was my bug -- generators are 0-based, 0..n-2, all present. Caught by the script printing 'gens used = 5/5' beside 'missing = [5]'
